scope_was_revised: THE_CUT.md said drop everything retired. A safety check found only 8 of 29 retired tables were genuinely unreferenced — the other 21 are named by code standing under features the founder KEPT, most importantly that accepting a creator pitch still writes a collab_agreements row. Recommended and accepted: finish the code removal, drop only the provably-safe eight, leave the rest. Dead data costs almost nothing; dead code runs. Code removal is reversible; dropping data is not.
dropped: referral_applications, enquiry_leads, lookbook_products, experience_products, creator_experiences, experience_themes, design_presets, design_tokens — 74 records, all exported to backend/exports/2026-09-02-pass4/ first.
what_the_74_records_were: The visual design system: moods, colour palettes, type styles and 24 ready-made shop themes, seeded 10-13 July 2026 and never read by one line of code in any app or website. The founder named it specifically.
a_number_i_had_wrong: I had quoted 85 design records from an earlier inventory. The real figure is 74 — the inventory counted page_layouts and shop_themes, neither of which exists in this database, and missed experience_themes (24 rows), which only surfaced when the drop failed on it.
the_guard_that_mattered: The first run ROLLED BACK ENTIRELY. design_presets had a dependent object and the script refuses CASCADE on purpose, so the whole transaction aborted rather than silently destroying the dependency. Chasing it down found experience_themes (unlisted, 24 rows) and — critically — that experience_templates is referenced by section_config, the LIVE table holding the shelves the shopper app renders. Without the no-CASCADE rule the first run would have reported success and taken a live constraint with it.
two_traps_caught_before_the_run: restaurant_reviews was on the original list and is a KEPT feature wearing a retired era name — empty today, joined on every product card. product_addon_groups sounds like dish toppings; the fashion product grid reads it on every row. Empty is not evidence of unused.
verified_after: people 129 · businesses 9 · products 48 · campaigns 12 · contracts 6 · sales 16 · browse tree 333 · live app shelves 6 — all unchanged.
